_comment: B3 ui.json — the reference fixture of the `ui` family: the keys it carries are schema-valid, so the 'reference fixture resolves end-to-end' tests exercise them at once. It is NOT exhaustive, and nothing keeps it in step with ui.schema.json: `ui.syncDocumentLang` and `ui.interactiveShapes` are declared by the schema and absent here. A key added to the schema does not land in this file on its own. Several values are picked distinct from code defaults (theme:dark, permalink.mode:query, positions:topright) so per-value tests can distinguish a real read from a default fallback. The table panel config moved to modules.table (config/plugins/table.json) — extraction roadmap table S4. The filter/search panel config moved to modules.filter (config/plugins/filter.json) — capacité in-core filter S5. The legend config (showLegend + legendConfig) moved to modules.legend (config/plugins/legend.json) — capacité in-core legend S10/F2. The share button flag (showShareButton) moved to modules.permalink.share — sub-feature of the in-core permalink capability (share S12 → permalink S13/F7).
